66. Plus One

Large integer array plus one...
input_format: An array of digits representing a large integer.
output_format: The array of digits after incrementing by one.
explanation: We iterate through the digits array from right to left. If a digit is less than 9, we increment it and return the result. If it is 9, we set it to 0 and continue to the next digit. If we reach the end of the loop (all digits were 9), we prepend 1 to the array.
